label: National Landsat II investigation publishes its final report
summary: DSIR’s Physics and Engineering Laboratory coordinated a national Landsat II investigation with surveying, geological, forestry, agricultural and university contributors. The September 1977 report names authors and institutional affiliations and records the image-processing and applied mapping work.

sources.label: Ellis, Thomas and McDonnell (eds), Landsat II Investigation Programme, PEL Report 587, September 1977, affiliations p.9 and contents pp.10–13
